name.gu: Elements of Mechanical Engineering (મેકેનિકલ એન્જિનિયરિંગના મૂળતત્ત્વો)

title.gu: પરિચય અને Basic Mechanical Tools – ઉપયોગ

topics: Force, pressure, energy, work, power, system, heat, temperature, specific heat and prime movers
Listed mechanical components, pipe fittings, hand tools, power tools and Industry 4.0
Vapour/gas, perfect gas and Boyle/Charles/combined laws
Gas constants, NTP/STP and Cp–Cv relation; no derivation
Pure substance, steam formation and types
Degree/heat of superheat, dryness/quality, wetness and priming concepts
IBR, boiler classification, Cochran and Babcock & Wilcox
Functions of mountings and accessories; taught in practical hours
units.hours_note: Syllabus shows no theory hours; Unit 4 covered in practical hours. Zero is not a claim of no teaching.

topics: IC/EC comparison, classification and main engine parts
Four-stroke petrol/diesel, cycle comparison, CNG and EV; no numericals
Types; reciprocating/centrifugal construction and working; priming
Principle, types, applications and single-stage reciprocating construction/working
Shaft/axle; belt, chain, friction and gear drives
Refrigerant function; vapour compression; domestic refrigerator; window/split AC
Hoisting, conveying, surface and overhead equipment

syllabus_note: Unit 4 is covered in practical hours and has 15% listed weightage. Its theory hours are shown as a dash in the syllabus; represented by 0 with explanatory metadata. Unit table totals 45 theory hours and 100% weightage.
practicals: Demonstrate listed mechanical items and hand/power tools; prepare sketches/specifications/applications report
Make a simple pipe layout from an approved drawing
books: N. M. Bhatt and J. R. Mehta — Elements of Mechanical Engineering
G. S. Sawhney — Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering
Sadhu Singh — Elements of Mechanical Engineering
